name: govuk-ai-components
description: GOV.UK Design System component registry for AI coding agents. Self-contained, accessible government components with full adaptation and coordination metadata.

designSystem.name: GOV.UK Design System (govuk-frontend)
designSystem.notes: Ground truth: govuk-frontend@6.5.1 installed as an EXACT devDependency. Two-axis verification: the .njk templates are the markup ground truth and dist/govuk/govuk-frontend.min.css the styling ground truth. A class can be canonical markup with no CSS rules (e.g. govuk-table__head) — the classCheck allowlist distinguishes the three categories (structural, app layer, pre-v4 drift).

metadataCategories.discovery: Facets for filtering in code (not sent to model)
metadataCategories.selection: useWhen/avoidWhen — helps choose the right component

gaps.reason: GOV.UK Design System deliberately ships no card component — flatten content to GOV.UK patterns
gaps.consequence: Do not add a card component; flatten content to GOV.UK patterns (task-list, summary-list, heading+link)
gaps.source: GOV.UK Design System published components list (https://design-system.service.gov.uk/components/) — no card component is published

gaps.reason: GOV.UK advises simple selects in transactional services; autocomplete patterns are service-specific

staticView.note: Resolved-view generation input (see _base/generate-resolved-view.mjs). Tiles are self-contained; no design-system CSS injection needed.
